<span class="status">In development.</span>

A three-camera system to estimate the position and orientation of a vehicle in a test tank. It is intended as a reference for testing vehicle estimators. Nothing has been demonstrated yet.

*This platform supports our research program in [Underwater perception and state estimation](../research.qmd#underwater-perception).*
